class.name: SteamApps
class.brief_description: Reads Steam app and DLC metadata and issues optional DLC install requests.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.apps]. Call its methods on the main thread while its client scope is active. Store availability, local subscription, and installation are separate Steam queries. Local metadata is suitable for presentation. Multiplayer entitlement decisions use a verified server-side identity and ownership check.

method.name: available_languages
method.description: Returns the app's configured Steam language codes in Steam's order, or an empty array when unavailable.

method.name: beta_branch
method.description: Returns the selected named beta branch. An empty string indicates the default branch or unavailable data.

method.name: build_id
method.description: Returns Steam's build ID for the current app. Returns [code]0[/code] when Steam has no build ID for this process, including launches outside a Steam download or an inactive client scope.

method.name: current_language
method.description: Returns the Steam language code selected for this game, or an empty string when unavailable. For the Steam client interface language, use [method SteamUtils.ui_language].

method.name: dlc
method.description: Returns a detached typed catalog for the current app with at most 256 entries in Steam's order. Steam may limit which entries it reports. Use known DLC AppIDs for required content. The [member SteamDlcInfo.available] flag describes visibility on the Steam store.

method.name: download_progress
method.description: Reads a progress snapshot for the optional DLC identified by [param dlc_app_id]. When Steam reports no active download, the query succeeds with an inactive [SteamDlcProgress]. Returns an error for an invalid AppID, unavailable interface, or byte counts beyond the signed integer range.

method.name: install_dlc
method.description: Issues an installation request for an optional DLC AppID associated with this game. Steam's local subscription check must report ownership. [constant OK] confirms that the request was issued. Use [method download_progress], [method is_dlc_installed], or [signal dlc_installed] to observe installation.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active client exposes the Steam Apps interface on the main thread.

method.name: is_dlc_installed
method.description: Returns whether the signed-in account owns and has installed the DLC identified by [param app_id]. Returns [code]false[/code] for invalid or unavailable queries.

method.name: is_subscribed_to_app
method.description: Returns whether the signed-in account has a Steam subscription to the app identified by [param app_id]. The AppID must be positive. Returns [code]false[/code] when the query is invalid or unavailable.

method.name: notification_session_id
method.description: Returns the nonzero decimal session ID Steam supplied when opening a Game Notification. Returns an empty string when absent, invalid, or unavailable. Ask the game's backend to authorize the selected session for the authenticated player before loading it.

method.name: owns_dlc
method.description: Returns Steam's local subscription state for the supplied DLC AppID. Use it as an ownership hint in the UI. Use [method is_dlc_installed] to check whether the local content is installed.

method.name: uninstall_dlc
method.description: Issues a removal request for the selected optional DLC. Call after the player confirms removal. [constant OK] confirms that the request was issued. Use [method is_dlc_installed] to check the resulting state.

signal.name: dlc_installed
signal.description: Emitted when Steam reports installation of the specified DLC AppID to the active client scope. Refresh the local content catalog before presenting the DLC as playable.

signal.name: notification_session_requested
signal.description: Emitted when Steam supplies a valid Game Notification session ID while the game is running. Validate session membership before resuming it.
